theorems.name: Submission.cbrld_im_degree_zero_eq_zero_of_mass_lt_one
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ∀ (P : ℕ) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 0), IsIntegerMultiplicity Z → Z.mass < 1 → Z = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
